description: Toy sandwich fixings are spread out on the bed: two slices of bread, a fried egg piece, bacon strips, a cheese square, cucumber slices, onion rings, and a tomato slice, with a small green plate in front. The left hand steadies the green plate while the right hand repeatedly reaches to the ingredient pile on the right, lifts one piece at a time, and places it onto the stack—starting with bread on the plate, then adding cheese, a round deli-meat piece, bacon, cucumbers, the fried egg, onion ring, tomato, and finally topping it with the second bread slice.
